units.source_text: 这个时候，两辆人力车经过弥漫着海腥味的墓地外面。

en.t: At that moment, two rickshaws passed outside the graveyard, where the smell of the sea hung in the air.

units.source_text: 粘着牡蛎壳的矮树篱里面，有几座黑乎乎的石塔。

en.t: Inside the low hedge, with oyster shells clinging to it, stood several dark stone towers.

units.source_text: 他眺望着在那些石塔对面闪烁着微光的大海，不知为何，突然对她的丈夫——没能俘获她的心的丈夫，感到十分鄙视……

en.t: As he gazed at the sea faintly glimmering beyond those stone towers, for some reason he suddenly felt deep contempt for her husband, the husband who had failed to win her heart...
